description: Local marketplace hosting the Qubika Livecoding plugin from this project directory

plugins.name: qubika-livecoding
plugins.description: Standardized Data Analyst interview kit: live SQL exercises (embedded DuckDB, ephemeral public link, Ctrl+C kills it), pre-call CV and screening-notes prep, and a post-call assessment written from the transcript and the live SQL log against a shared template and DASRI/DASRII criteria. One plugin, one process, for every interviewer.
